issue.title: Optional capture form that appends an intention to today's or a period's note

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add an optional capture grammar form that appends one intention to today's daily note (or a named period such as this week) through bob's guarded `bob periods update` writer (`intentions.insert` at the end), so Bryan can set intentions from Bob Mac Capture or a terminal without opening Obsidian. The capture preview should show the target note and the resulting count, and honor the soft cap of three only as an info hint (Bryan's text is never refused).

Proposed scope: pick a sigil or route form consistent with decisions:capture-sigils-say-where-what-how (and its partial supersessions), implement parse/preview/complete/submit in bob's capture engine, route the write through the same planner `bob periods update` uses, update docs/capture.md, and coordinate the Mac client (decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client means the Mac app only renders bob's spans and preview).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202611/period_intentions.md asks the adopt phase to record "an optional capture sigil to append an intention" as a follow-up; capture grammar changes are governed by their own decision records and need a design pass that the intentions epic did not include. Proposed by bob-cli-nh.8 note #6; triaged by the bob-cli-nh land agent.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-nh's plan asked to record an optional capture sigil for appending intentions; it needs a capture-grammar design pass outside that epic.
